description: A sophisticated living room console vignette with dark charcoal-brown vertical wood panel cladding covering the entire back wall, adding deep texture and a moody masculine character. On the marble surface, a stack of four hardcover coffee-table books — including volumes labeled on their spines — sits alongside a small rectangular decorative box in dark wood with brass hardware. The floor is grey large-format stone tile. To the right, a low off-white fabric sofa partially visible at the frame edge holds a cognac-orange velvet throw cushion and a patterned geometric cushion in black and cream. A warm golden glow emanates from the left end of the console at table height, washing the lower portion of the paneled wall with amber warmth and illuminating the marble surface. Camera is at standing eye-level using a normal lens, wide three-quarter view of the full console and partial sofa. Camera pitch is level.
